subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: PER.VT.U.FUND.------COS.P.
description: Chart on book p. 144 (UPB(II)-6). PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; COS-P (cosmic particulars) is the partner. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From AFL-DY: HI-P (high purpose) and TR (transformation). From MT-INFO: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From TR: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). From IF-SPT: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis).
